activity.notes: Manuelito was a leading Diné headman, resistance leader and later advocate for the community and its children. The 1855 treaty provides a documented leadership anchor, and the representative community-activity interval continues through his later public involvement before his death in 1893. This does not assert an uninterrupted sole head-chieftainship, military command or formal office through the Long Walk and captivity.
